comment: Independent restore.c dorecover() and timeout.c restore_timers() witness: a debug gnomish Healer wishes for a lit blessed and a lit cursed wax candle on the same turn, so their burn timers share a timeout and insert_timer() puts the second ahead of the first; the different curse states keep the candles from merging into one stack and one timer. #timeout lists the queue, and the hero saves. Restoring reads the timers back in queue order and inserts each ahead of any timer with the same timeout, so #timeout lists the tied timers in reverse.
